events.name: Minnesota Twins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Taj Bradley pitched six innings of five-hit ball, Minnesota homered three times in the ninth inning to break open a close game, and the Twins beat the Kansas City Royals 5-1 on Thursday to avoid a three-game series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taj Bradley tosses 6 shutout innings, Minnesota homers 3 times in the 9th in a 5-1 win over KC

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Matt Olson, Dominic Smith and Mauricio Dubón hit solo homers, Reynaldo López gave up one run over five innings and the Atlanta Braves coasted to a 17-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Thursday night in the opener of a four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves ride an 8-run fifth inning and cruise past the Diamondbacks, 17-2

events.name: New York Mets at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — San Francisco rookie catcher Daniel Susac went 3 for 3 with a walk in his first major league start and the Giants rolled over the New York Mets 7-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Susac enjoys big night in first major league start as the Giants top Mets 7-2
